description: Calculate the classical Parashara Vimshottari Dasha planetary timeline (120-year cycle) for a person or founding event. Corresponds to the /dasha slash command. Requires birth date ('date', YYYY-MM-DD), birth time ('time', HH:MM, default '12:00'), and birth city ('city'). Returns current Mahadasha and Antardasha periods, active dates, psychological and karmic significance, upcoming macro-epochs, and a direct link to the interactive ERUX Dasha calendar.
